acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A calculateAllStrategies() function creates a FinancialSnapshot from the current Dexie database state (accounts, flexiFacility, income, expenses) and runs all 8 strategies.
The orchestrator calculates the baseline strategy first, then uses that result to compute monthsSaved and interestSaved metrics for all other strategies.
All 8 strategies (baseline, snowball, avalanche, flexi-chunking, aggressive-flexi, velocity-banking, hybrid-snowball, hybrid-avalanche) are executed and results collected.
Strategies that require a flexi facility return null gracefully when no flexi facility exists, and these nulls are filtered from the comparison results.
Calculation completes in under 3 seconds for typical scenarios (5-10 accounts, 360 months max projection) per NFR-P1.

A calculationStore (Zustand) stores calculation results: results (StrategyProjection[]), baseline (StrategyProjection | null), isCalculating (boolean), lastCalculated (string | null), error (string | null).
A useStrategies() hook provides React components access to: strategies, baseline, isCalculating, calculateStrategies(), bestStrategy.
User configuration from useStrategyConfig hook is passed to all strategy calculations, respecting chunk amount, payment frequency, and target account overrides.
While calculation is running, UI shows a loading state (skeleton loaders or spinner indicator).
Results are sorted by interest saved (highest savings first) by default in the store.

Unit tests verify: orchestrator creates correct FinancialSnapshot, baseline calculated first, all 8 strategies receive correct parameters, null strategies filtered, results sorted, loading state works.
If there are no accounts or accounts have zero total balance, orchestrator returns empty results with appropriate message (not an error).

node.purpose: Arbitrary precision decimal arithmetic for financial calculations

constraints.constraint: All monetary calculations must use big.js (ADR-003) for cent-level precision
Strategy Pattern (ADR-004) - all strategies implement DebtStrategy interface
Zustand for UI state (ADR-005) - calculationStore follows existing uiStore pattern
All 8 strategy calculations must complete in < 3 seconds for typical portfolio (5-10 accounts, 360 months)
Framework-agnostic calculation engine - no React dependencies in src/lib/calculations/
Baseline must be calculated first and passed to other strategies for comparison metrics
Strategies return null if they require flexi facility and none exists - these must be filtered
Strategy config from useStrategyConfig includes chunkAmount, paymentFrequency, targetAccountId
Use existing hook composition pattern - useStrategies should compose useAccounts, useFlexiFacility, useIncome, useExpenses, useStrategyConfig
Results sorted by interestSaved descending (highest savings first)
